Welcome to the world of air up®! 🎉 Here’s your quick guide to get started:

Fill your air up® bottle with plain water (yep, just water!).

Sip as usual—your brain will sense the taste by scent, so it feels like you’re drinking something delicious, but it’s actually just water! 😋

Absolutely! Here’s a super simple breakdown of the main air up® bottle options:

Twist: The classic, lightweight bottle—easy to use, great for everyday hydration. Handwash only unless it says “Made in Austria.” Perfect for still water lovers.
Twist Pro: An upgraded version! Dishwasher-safe (except some steel colours), has a detachable adapter for easy refilling, and a fancy mouthpiece. Works with still and sparkling water.
Twist Pro Steel: Just like Twist Pro, but made of double-walled stainless steel to keep your water cool for ages. Great for those who want premium style and insulation.
Click: Quick to open with a click lid, designed for still water only. Super easy and fun!
Tumbler: Sleek cup-style bottle with a straw and mouthpiece. Ideal for sipping on the go—fits most car cupholders!

Here’s how to use your air up® Twist bottle for the very first time:

Rinse all parts with lukewarm water and mild soap 🧼.
Insert the straw into the mouthpiece until it hits the marked line (tip pointing down).
Attach the mouthpiece (with straw) to the bottle body.
Place your pod on the mouthpiece, sticker facing up. Pull the pod up until you feel resistance—this activates the taste-by-scent magic!
Close the lid securely to make it leak-proof.
Attach the strap if you want to carry it easily.
Fill with plain water, sip upright, and listen for bubbles—that means it’s working! 😋
